properties.name: raf.rocketmq.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the RocketMQ integration.

properties.name: raf.rocketmq.name-server
properties.description: RocketMQ name server address, e.g. 127.0.0.1:9876. Supports multiple addresses separated by semicolons.

properties.name: raf.rocketmq.producer.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the RocketMQ producer.

properties.name: raf.rocketmq.producer.group
properties.description: Producer group name. Used for transaction message recovery.

properties.name: raf.rocketmq.producer.retry-times-when-send-failed
properties.description: Number of retry attempts when a synchronous send fails.

properties.name: raf.rocketmq.producer.retry-times-when-send-async-failed
properties.description: Number of retry attempts when an asynchronous send fails.

properties.name: raf.rocketmq.producer.max-message-size
properties.description: Maximum allowed message size in bytes. Default is 4 MB.

properties.name: raf.rocketmq.consumer.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the RocketMQ consumer.

properties.name: raf.rocketmq.consumer.consume-message-batch-max-size
properties.description: Maximum number of messages consumed in a single batch.

properties.name: raf.rocketmq.consumer.pull-batch-size
properties.description: Number of messages pulled from the broker in a single request.
